entities.name: Kolman
entities.description: One of twelve elders of Gatstaf who presided over Warin's hearing; later Eldrazified and killed by Halana and Alena.

entities.name: Gatstaf
entities.description: Village in the Ulvenwald of Kessig Province, Innistrad.

entities.name: Warin
entities.description: Farmer who claimed one of his cows ate the other.

entities.name: Halana
entities.description: Hunter who attended the hearing and later killed Kolman.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: Hunter who attended the hearing and later killed Kolman.

entities.name: Palters
entities.description: Victims of an apparent murder at the inn that disrupted the meeting.

events.summary: Kolman presides over Warin's hearing but cannot keep order, until the apparent murder of the Palters disrupts it.
events.quote: Kolman was presiding over the hearing

events.summary: Eldrazified Kolman is killed by Halana and Alena in the woods.
events.quote: The two hunters killed him and ran from the clearing together

relations.quote: Kolman was one of the twelve elders of Gatstaf
